notes: Opened all five listed sources live via Parallel web_fetch. The 1985 ASEAN agreement PDF (asean.org) supports Articles 1-6 exactly as summarised: recognition of domestic licences except temporary/provisional/learner's, temporary-stay scope, permitted classes, certified English translation, invalid or expired licences excluded, host-country standards and penalties; the signing place and date and the party list (in force 7 Jan 1988, Viet Nam accession 22 Jan 1997, Timor-Leste 24 Nov 2025, all eleven states) come from the ASEAN Secretariat treaty record. Circular 12/2025/TT-BCA on xaydungchinhsach.chinhphu.vn confirms Art. 18(7)(a)-(b) (exchange required unless a treaty Vietnam is party to provides otherwise), Art. 24(1)(a) and (1)(c) (3-month residence/official card; no exchange of temporary licences, IDPs, expired/damaged or non-competent-authority licences) and the rule that a Vietnam-issued 1968 IDP is not valid in Vietnam; the draft presents the no-exchange position as a reading of these two texts and never promises roadside acceptance. The US Embassy page supports the 'not valid', 'certain circumstances', obtain-a-local-licence wording and the exchange document list and 135,000 VND fee verbatim; the GOV.UK safety page supports the 1968 IDP plus licence rule, third-party insurance, helmet, photo-ID copy, passport-deposit, drink-driving, accident (criminal charges, compensation, travel ban) and motorbike-safety points. Business name, address, hotline 0334 699 969 and 09:00-21:00 daily match config/business-facts.json; no prices or unconfirmed policies are asserted, and the four internal links exist in the live inventory. A 9-gram overlap scan found no copied passages beyond the treaty's title; image 662 alt text fits a Hanoi rental article.
